# FastPress Labs — AI-assisted software studio (full agent brief)

Generated 26 Oct 2026. Storefront: https://fastpresspages.github.io/agency/
Org: https://github.com/fastpresspages (7 public repos)

## Who we are
One-developer studio by Meet Shah (https://fastpresspages.github.io/hire-me/), using AI tools under human direction. All public work is audited and dated. No fabricated clients, metrics or testimonials anywhere.

## Services and starting prices (USD)
1. Build: landing/launch pages from $750; web apps & MVPs from $1,500; docs/template sites from $500.
2. Agents & automation: chat/support agents from $750; MCP servers & agent skills from $750; workflow automation from $500.
3. Data & knowledge: RAG/knowledge bases from $750; dashboards & reports from $500; deep research briefs from $300.
4. Launch & growth: launch audit + fixes from $150; SEO & copy packs from $300; care plans from $100/mo.
5. Advising: AI strategy call from $150; tool selection from $300; team workshops from $400.
Prices are starting points, not quotes. Every engagement: written scope, fixed price, 50% upfront, refundable before the first paid week.

## Process
Enquiry → reply in 1 business day → written scope + fixed quote → weekly demos → delivery to a repo you own (private or public; NDA fine). Apache-2.0 by default for our OSS; client code belongs to the client.
